evidenceLayout: Per-plan evidence under tmp/clm-s725/<planId>/ (baselines and progress evidence) with gate runs under tmp/clm-s725/<planId>/final/. Before repeating a gate run, move final/ to attempt-<n>/ inside the plan directory. Retry loops write <name>-1.log..<name>-3.log and copy the green attempt to <name>.log. Reconciliation output goes under tmp/clm-s725/reconcile/. tmp/ is git-ignored; store only .log, .txt, .json and binaries there (clm-02 stores nodetto-cli-baseline), never .ts files, because bun test collects stray .ts files. Cargo output goes to the git-ignored target/, which every plan declares as artifactRoots ["target"].

reviewContext.userProblem: Users of nodetto-cli lack: deterministic layered and route-only arranging with label placement, port spreading and self-loop sides (A1-A5); a frame-move opt-out (A6); acceptable native performance when an edit batch enables routingAvoidObstacles on about 50 edges (over two minutes today, A7); a three-way JSONL merge usable as a git merge driver and a determinism guarantee for SVG export (B1-B3); update with label, rejection of unknown operation fields with suggestions, collapsed warnings and --quiet (C1-C3); and lint for ERD/node overlaps, --fix text wrapping with CJK breaking, and missing image references (D1-D3).
requiredOutcomes: A1-A7: arrange --mode layered (--direction LR|TB, --frames) and --mode route (--ids, --reset-manual) exist with deterministic, idempotent, tested output; label placement avoids overlaps and lint --metrics reports edge-crossing and edge-label-overlap counts; ports spread along sides; self-loops use unused sides; carryMembers:false moves only the frame and the default is documented; the A7 obstacle-routing batch fixture (20 states, 50 edges, 3 frames) passes natively within 10000 ms with byte-identical output.

B1-B3: nodetto-cli merge performs a per-element, per-field three-way merge (ours kept on conflicts, arrays atomic, delete rules from design B1), reports conflicts on stderr and exits 0/1/2; a git end-to-end test with .gitattributes merge=nodetto passes; export determinism is tested and documented.

C1-C3: update accepts label for every labeled type; unknown fields in every edit operation are rejected with a suggestion and the valid list; identical warnings collapse with a count; global --quiet suppresses warnings without changing exit codes.

D1-D3: lint reports node-overlap on erd, state, flowchart and uml pages; lint --fix wraps overflowing label/note text with CJK-aware breaking; lint reports image-missing for unresolvable relative semantic.src through CommandIo.

Bun and native parity tests cover the new commands and flags; CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true mise run verify and mise run test-cli pass (3-attempt retry on native deadlines); help and docs describe every new command, mode, flag and field.
nonGoals: Rust or native host changes (an A7 host-side root cause is a Step-5 blocker, not in any writePaths).
Changing tidy, overlaps, edit --arrange, move, the frame-move default, the app's live mergeDocuments, or text-layout export warnings.
Item-by-item list merge, a --format flag for merge, an SVG merge driver, UI inspector controls.
Text-layout rules on erd, state or uml pages (Q1).
Relaxing any existing test deadline; any binary-less native parity run; version bumps, tags, releases or pushes; server, auth or deployment code.
constraints: Maximum concurrency: feature plans write only their own modules; only clm-09 edits commands.ts, help.ts, cli.ts, main.ts, native-engine.ts, mcp.ts, packages/core/src/index.ts, docs/cli.md, README.md, design-docs/specs/export.md and design-cli-ai-drawing.md. Five plans run in wave 1, two in wave 2, wiring in wave 3.
Feature CLI modules import new core symbols by relative path until clm-09 adds the exports and switches to @nodetto/core.
Strict TS; core code safe under noUncheckedIndexedAccess; Boa rules: no regex split on whole documents, no per-point destructuring in hot geometry loops.
Neutral self-authored fixtures (widgets, orders, Idle, Running, Stage0-Stage2); never name external issues, organizations, reporters or downstream products.

Every verification command exits 0 and runs tests; native parity always sets NODETTO_CLI_TEST_BINARY; native deadline tests get 3 attempts; CPU time compared with /usr/bin/time -p against clm-02's pre-change baseline binary.

Every plan declares artifactRoots ["target"] and lists every edited file in writePaths; each plan edits only its own progress log; no worktrees, branches, commits, broad formatters or lockfile changes by workers.
Additive and backward compatible; AGENTS.md applies; no emojis; cargo with CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true.

A wave-1 or wave-2 typecheck or native build failure caused only by a sibling plan's in-progress file is drift: record it, wait, and rerun; never edit the sibling's file.
